author: Bobby Grayson
description: Sys.terminate stays the primitive 'remove p, queue r to links and watchers'. signalE: (q,src,.kill) with live q -> terminate q .error regardless of traps. runE: self-exit reason r -> terminate p r.propagated (kill -> error). A trapping actor at pid 0 can now die of a kill signal, so the supervisor/watchdog proofs need 'no (0,_, .kill) in signals'; proved as Sys.NoKillTo 0 (SysProps) preserved alongside Inv rather than as a new Inv field, to avoid re-threading every Grows call.
title: Reason.kill + Reason.propagated; signalE checks kill before traps; kill-freedom proved as a separate Sys.NoKillTo invariant beside Inv
